Bhuneshwar Sahu vs The State Of Jharkhand on 12 August,
2015

Author: D. N. Upadhyay
Bench: D. N. Upadhyay

In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A. B. A. No.2347 of 2015
 -----
 Bhuneshwar Sahu.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
------
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice D. N. Upadhyay

For the Petitioner : Mr. Chandra S. Pandey, Advocate  For the State : A.P.P.
 ------
02/12.08.2015 : Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner is an accused in a case registered under Sections 3(zz)(iii) and (viii) of the F.S.S. Act,
punishable under Section 59(iii) read with Sections 26 and 27 of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.
The petitioner has been prosecuted for having been found in possession of adulterated food.
It it is submitted that no injury has been caused to any one.

Only on the basis of report submitted,
complaint has been filed under Section 59(iii) of the Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.
Counsel for the State has opposed the petitioner's prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from today and, if he does so, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand) with two sureties of like amount, each, to the satisfaction of the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Latehar in connection with C.G. Case No.5 of 2013, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(D. N. Upadhyay, J.) Sanjay/
